title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics priority sampling improvements and SLO toolkit integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: on-call diagnostics were returning noisy, low-value runbook suggestions under heavy alert churn. This PR improves priority sampling for oncall diagnostics by combining SLO-impact weighting, recent anomaly signals, and deterministic reservoir sampling; it also integrates sampling hooks into the slo-toolkit so downstream scoring and runbook linking get consistent samples. Changes include a new sampling policy engine, rate controls per-SLO, and a migration path that keeps default behavior unchanged until opt-in. Testing: unit tests + integration tests that exercise end-to-end diagnostics with synthetic SLO events; CI validated flaky integration test rerun. Rollout: feature flagged; rollout plan includes gradual 10%->50%->100% ramp with monitoring dashboards and automatic rollback on elevated false-positive rate. Related: Linear ENG-4281 https://linear.app/issue/ENG-4281, support ticket SUP-3321. Checklist: - [x] Design doc and signals spec added; - [x] Unit + integration tests added; - [x] Feature-flag gate and config knobs; - [x] Runbook links updated; - [x] Observability dashboards and alerts included.
